regionDisplayHint: Show this algorithm's yellow dashed regions in live preview and gateway details independently of other algorithms. Saved immediately; the editor and recognition results stay unchanged.
editHint: Drag a white vertex to reshape the region or drag inside to move it. Select a drawing tool to replace the region.
drawFour: Click four corners in boundary order. The fourth closes the shape. Esc cancels.
drawPolygon: Click vertices in boundary order, then the first vertex or Finish drawing to close. Enter finishes; Esc cancels.
noImage: No snapshot loaded. Open the preview and capture a frame.
tooFewPoints: A polygon needs at least three vertices.
tooManyPoints: A polygon supports up to twenty vertices.
outOfBounds: Vertices must stay within the image.
duplicatePoints: Vertices cannot overlap. Undo the duplicate point and choose another position.
selfIntersection: Region edges cannot cross. Adjust vertices in boundary order.
tooSmall: The region is too small. Increase its area.
finishBeforeSave: Finish or cancel the region being drawn first.
templateScope: Templates store reusable regions and alarm conditions. Select or copy them into a task to apply them; publishing does not update running tasks.
taskScope: Edit this camera's alarm region here. Save the recognition configuration to apply it.
importHint: Copy a region from a published template while keeping this task's classes, conditions and schedule. Check its position against the current camera image.
templateLoadFailed: Could not load templates. Check rule query permissions and your connection, then retry.
noTemplates: No enabled, published templates are available. Publish a template in the rule center first.
noVersions: This template has no available published versions. Refresh the template list.
saveToApply: You can adjust it by dragging. Save the recognition configuration to apply it.
invalidRule: Invalid rule format. Check the regions and alarm conditions.
